sentences.en: This squirrel shall be henceforth known as "The Cute One."
sentences.zh: 从此以后，这只松鼠将被称为“萌萌哒”。

sentences.en: A squirrel is taking a bath in the pond.
sentences.zh: 一只松鼠正在池塘里洗澡。

sentences.en: Ah! Ah! Ah! A drunk squirrel! that will be very funny.
sentences.zh: 啊！啊！啊！一只醉醺醺的松鼠！这将会非常有趣。

senses.zh: 贮藏（供以后使用）；不停（或不安）地探寻
